messages:
sophia: heads-up: perigee-13b (int8) onboarding canary is flaking with OOMs for long-session customers. opening a quick triage thread.
dan: saw spikes in OOM alerts around 03:20 UTC. pattern: long histories (~3.5k tokens) + generation. batch size default 5, max_new_tokens 180.
rafa: allocator telemetry shows lots of sub-64KB free holes after multiple gen steps. frag_index reported 0.41 before crash.
meera: host dump excerpt: ```CUDA OOM on allocation\nGPU total 48GB, used highwater 47.3GB, free 0.7GB\nEstimated KV cache: 36.8GB\nSmall free segments: 1324 (<64KB)\nRequest token estimate (history+gen): 3678\nBatch size: 5, max_new_tokens: 180```
sophia: int8 packing changed some layer buffer sizes which interact poorly with our slab allocator. suspecting allocation pattern mismatch causing non-coalescing frees.
dan: immediate mitigations to try: 1) reduce hosted default max_new_tokens for perigee/int8 to 96 2) enable a small-alloc coalescer pool 3) add per-session soft-truncate when estimated_context > 3200.
rafa: ran a quick sim: small-alloc-coalescer + max_new_tokens=96 reduced frag_index 0.41 -> 0.17 and eliminated OOMs across 2k synthetic long sessions. tradeoff: p95 latency increased ~10ms on small requests, ~120ms on longest ones.
meera: quality check: int8 vs fp16 on our long-doc summarization eval: METEOR -0.8 pts, ROUGE-L -0.6. smaller gen caps reduced the gap slightly (METEOR -0.5 at cap=96).
dan: routing policy proposal: tag /summaries and /doc-qa as quality_protected. policy: preferred_model=perigee:fp16, fallback=perigee:int8 when system_capacity_high. also add on-the-fly route-level override when eval drift exceeds threshold.
sophia: runtime change: implement dynamic microbatching for requests where context_estimate > 2500 (split token generation across per-item microbatches to avoid simultaneous KV peaks). microbench shows mem highwater down 15% with ~5% latency cost.
rafa: also prototyping async KV compaction during idle windows; early results show reduced long-term frag accumulation without client-impacting stalls. more R&D needed.
meera: rollout plan: 1) canary flags: max_new_tokens=96, small_alloc_coalescer=on, dynamic_microbatch=on 2) tag summarize routes as quality_protected -> prefer fp16 3) 72h soak against mixed-length corpus + focused long-doc evals 4) alerts: OOM_rate >0.03% or frag_index >0.25 OR ROUGE-L drop >0.5 triggers rollback/route-fallback.
dan: I'll add dashboard tiles for frag_index and per-route fallback counts. also add automated task: if a route shows ROUGE-L drift >0.4 persistently, switch that route to fp16 and notify owners.
sophia: opening PR for the default change + runtime toggles. attaching eval snapshots and microbench CSV.
deploy-bot: canary deployment scheduled: perigee-13b:int8 flags=[max_new_tokens=96,small_alloc_coalescer=on,dynamic_microbatch=on]; target=eng-staging; started=2026-03-27T03:45Z
rafa: follow-ups: docs for customers recommending fp16 for "very long" contexts and a sample route policy snippet for Dedicated. opening ticket to track async KV compaction and allocator redesign.
sophia: thanks all 44d. will report back after soak window.
